rooms.2200: The Dark Woods crowd the track so closely that daylight comes down grey and thin, and the trunks stand black with damp. Roots break through the leaf-mould like knuckles, and a rank tang of old woodsmoke hangs between the boughs. The track runs north toward the Black Forest and south through more of the woods. Someone has hacked a rough notch into every tenth tree, high up where only a giant could reach.
rooms.4325: Here the Black Forest earns its name: the trunks are wet and sooty, and the canopy shuts out nearly all of the sky. Pale shelves of fungus crowd the rotting logs. Paths lead north into the Murky Forest and south back to the Dark Woods, while a trodden gap in the ferns opens west toward a pool. Splintered bones lie scattered in the moss, cracked open for their marrow.
rooms.4320: Mist pools between the trunks of the Murky Forest, and everything beyond a few paces is a smudge of grey. Tracks lead north toward the edge of the wood, east and west into the black timber, and south the way you came. A stout old oak leans over the junction, its lowest limbs thick enough to climb into, and tattered rags are tied along them. The ground squelches with every step.
rooms.4315: The trees thin here, and pale light spills in from open ground ahead. Brambles crowd the margin of the wood, snagged with tufts of coarse black hair. The way north leads out to a field and a waterhole, a track east dives into the Dark Forest, and another runs south into the Murky Forest. The edge of the wood runs on west along the field's border.
rooms.4310: A muddy waterhole spreads across the middle of the field, its banks churned by huge flat footprints and fouled with scraps of gnawed gristle. Reeds stand brown at the margin, and flies drift in clouds over the shallows. Open ground continues north and west, a small clump of trees waits east, and the forest edge begins south.
rooms.4306: Coarse grass hisses in the wind across this stretch of open field, tall enough to hide a crouching man. A line of flattened stems runs through it where something heavy has dragged a load. The field slopes away south toward a muddy waterhole, and a greener meadow stretches west.
rooms.4305: Bright grass carpets this field, startlingly green after the black woods, and wild clover grows in thick patches. A split in the earth gapes to the north, ragged at its lips. Meadow lies east and south, and a small copse of pale trees grows west. A cold breeze carries the faint smell of cookfire from somewhere far off.
rooms.4303: The ground splits here into a deep crack, its sides raw red clay with wedged stones. Water has run down the cleft for ages and left a slick of green slime on the rocks. The meadow lies south, and a flight of narrow steps climbs the far wall of the crack. Bleached ribs, each as long as a spear, jut from the clay.
rooms.4302: Steps hardly wider than a boot are cut into the cliff, worn hollow in the middle by long use. The rock is wet and the wind tugs at your cloak. Below, the steps drop into a crack in the meadow; above, they climb to the cliff's brink. One slip would mean a very long fall.
rooms.4309: Trampled grass and old fire-blackened stones mark this part of the field, where a hunting party once stopped to eat. Splintered bones are heaped against a lichened boulder. Open field stretches north and east, a great oak stands to the west, and the forest begins again south.
rooms.4314: A ragged line of oaks and hawthorn marks the boundary between field and forest. Claw marks as long as a forearm score the nearest trunk, and the bark hangs from it in strips. Meadow lies north, the edge of the wood runs on east, and the forest deepens south and thickens into dense woods west.
rooms.4319: The black trunks stand shoulder to shoulder, slick with moss on every side but the one that gets the rain. Little grows underfoot save pale ferns and fallen needles. The wood runs north to its edge, east into the Murky Forest, west among yet more black trees, and south down a slope toward a pool. A bundle of knotted grass hangs from a branch, a crude ogre charm against bad luck.
rooms.4324: A round black pool lies in a hollow of the forest floor, its rim ringed with stunted willows and flat stones. The water is cold and still, and pale shapes of old bone show beneath the surface. The Black Forest closes around the hollow: it rises north and east, and a dim way leads west under more trees.
rooms.4323: This is yet more black forest, and no kinder than the last. Thorns and low branches snatch at your sleeves, and the light is a dim green murk. Only two ways lead on from the tangle: north through the trunks and east toward the glimmer of a pool. A huge ragged nest of sticks and hide scraps wedges into the crook of the lowest bough.
rooms.4318: A lightning-split tree dominates this part of the Black Forest, its ruined trunk hollow and charred. A stout limb offers a way up into the crown. Trails run north into dense woods, east toward more black timber, south into a thicket, and west beneath the boughs of a gnarled old forest.
rooms.4313: The wood is so dense here that you push through rather than walk, shouldering aside curtains of ivy and hanging vines. Dead leaves lie ankle-deep, and the air is thick and still. A great tree looms through the gloom to the north, the track runs east to the forest's edge, south into the Black Forest, and west into quieter woods.
rooms.4308: An enormous oak stands alone in a clearing, older than any wall in the realm, its trunk wider than a hut and its roots rising like the backs of buried beasts. A rope ladder of knotted hide hangs toward a platform high among the boughs, and you can climb up. Fields lie east, a copse north, the roar of falling water comes from the west, and thick forest crowds south.
rooms.4304: A small copse of birch and rowan huddles here, its leaves rattling in the breeze. Moss cushions the ground between the white trunks, and enormous bare footprints have pressed deep into it. The copse opens east onto a green field and south toward a great oak.
rooms.4307: A stream tumbles over a lip of black rock in a thin white veil, and the pool at its foot churns with spray. Ferns cling to the wet stone and the grass is slick underfoot. A great oak stands to the east, and a forest track slips south through the trees. The roar of the fall drowns every other sound.
rooms.4312: Tall beech and oak stand well spaced here, and the forest floor is deep with brown leaf litter. Sunlight dapples the ground in coins of gold, the only cheer in this part of the realm. The noise of falling water drifts from the north. Tracks lead east into denser wood and south through more forest.
rooms.4317: The trees grow gnarled and twisted here, wrapped in strangling ivy. A narrow crevice splits the rocks to the south, while a trail leads north through the wood and a heavy path runs east to the Black Forest. Old bones, snapped for the marrow, litter the leaves underfoot.
rooms.4322: The forest floor breaks into a narrow crevice between two walls of mossy rock, so tight you must turn sideways to pass. Cold air breathes out of the cracks, and the light fades to a green twilight. There is no way on; the only road out is back north to the forest. Deep scratches in the stone show where something stout once dug.
rooms.4326: A platform of rough planks is lashed across the boughs of the great oak, its rails made of split saplings tied with hide. A heap of moth-eaten skins is nailed in one corner, and the wind sways the whole structure. The only way out is down, back to the ground beneath the oak. Far below, the field is a green patch among the trees.
rooms.4327: You cling to a broad limb of a lightning-scarred tree, the bark flaking under your hands. Through gaps in the leaves the forest floor is a dim tangle below, and smoke climbs from some distant fire. The way down is the way you came, back to the black forest floor.
rooms.4311: A small clump of ash trees grows on a rise, their trunks bent all one way by the wind. The grass beneath them is worn bare by something that sleeps here, and a ring of fire-blackened stones holds nothing but cold ash. The field falls away west toward the waterhole, and a dark forest creeps in from the south.
rooms.4316: Twisted roots grip the soil like talons in the Dark Forest, and the canopy is so thick that noon feels like dusk. A trail of snapped twigs and flattened ferns leads north to a small clump of trees. The black wood continues south, and the forest edge lies west.
rooms.4321: The trees lean in over the trail here, and thorns have grown across what once was a way on. Scraps of dried meat hang from a line stretched between two trunks, curing in the damp air. The path winds north to the Dark Forest and west to the Murky Forest.
rooms.4328: The oak's crown sways gently around you, and the limb beneath your feet is as thick as a barrel. Rags and feathers dangle from the twigs in knotted charms. Over the tops of the trees a thin pillar of smoke rises far off toward the horizon. The only way off the branch is down, to the misty forest floor.
rooms.2201: The path through the Dark Woods narrows to a deer-track between rank bushes, with branches meeting overhead. Rusted iron spikes have been hammered into several trunks and hung with strings of knucklebones. Black woods lead north, and the track opens south at a small crossing. The air smells of resin and wet earth.
rooms.2202: Three tracks meet in a small clearing in the forest, and a split stump marks the crossing. A trail runs north into the Dark Woods, another east into denser forest, and a third south to where the trees give way to hills. Pale lichen grows on the stump, and a few crow feathers lie pinned beneath a stone.
rooms.2204: Dense forest presses in from every side, the trunks knotted with creeper and the undergrowth chest-high and wet. A narrow lane has been broken through it by something broad and heavy, leaving snapped saplings along both edges. The lane bends south toward a darker path and west back to a small intersection. Dripping leaves patter softly on your shoulders.
rooms.2205: The Dark Forest Path is a hollow of trodden mud between black trunks, rutted deep by great bare feet. Strings of hair-braided charms swing from the lowest branches and clack together in the draught. A boggier way wanders east, a bend of the path lies south, and the dense forest rises to the north. The air tastes of peat and smoke.

2227.description: The path sinks into black mud here, and each step comes up with a slow sucking sound. Rotten planks have been laid across the worst of the ooze, and a green film of scum covers the pools on either side. The swamp stretches east along the path, and firmer ground lies west toward the forest. Midges swarm thick over the stagnant water.

2228.description: Tussocks of yellow sedge rise out of the swamp on both sides of the path, with brown water glinting between them. Half-sunken logs make a crooked causeway of sorts, slick with algae. The path runs east and west, and in either direction the way is no cleaner. A low pale mist hangs low over the pools.

2229.description: Dead trees lean out of the stagnant swamp like gallows, bare of bark and hung with trailing moss. The path is little more than a ridge of peat, soft and dangerous to the side. It continues east to a sharp turn and west the way you came. Bubbles of foul gas rise and burst in the black water.

2230.description: The path bends hard here, skirting a deep, brown pool fringed with rotting reeds. Great ragged claw-prints cross the mud where something came up out of the water to cool itself. One arm of the path leads south into the mist, and the other runs west along the ridge of peat. The stink of bog and rot is close to overpowering.

2231.description: A fog thickens as the path crosses a wide flat of black marsh. Skeletal reeds rattle in the damp wind, and a few withered gibbets of twisted wire hold only scraps of cloth. To the north the path returns toward a sharp bend; ahead south, the mist swallows the track entirely. Everything is wet and grey.

2233.description: The mist is so thick here that you can barely see your own hands, and the world shrinks to a few yards of dripping peat. Shapes that might be trees or standing figures loom up and fade. Only one way is certain: back along the path to the north. The silence is broken now and then by a distant, heavy splash.

rooms.2206: The path turns sharply here, bending around a boulder as tall as a hut and daubed with a red handprint. Old campfire ash and gnawed bones scatter the ground at its foot. The track leads north toward the dark forest path and west toward a place where the ground is stained dark. Crows have scratched the earth bare along the verge.
rooms.2207: This is the Bloody Intersection, and it has earned the name. The packed earth is stained brown-red in broad splashes, the flat rocks are crusted black, and bones of every size are heaped against the stones, some still hung with rags of flesh. A path leads east toward a turning, another runs west along a rocky track, and a steep hillside rises south. The ogres feast here, and their leavings stink in the heat.
rooms.2210: A steep rocky hillside rises here, strewn with loose scree that rattles away underfoot. Scrubby gorse clings in the crevices between boulders. The slope flattens to the north at a bloody crossing, runs on east to level ground, south toward a huge tree, and west across sparse foothills. Cold wind whips the grey stones.
rooms.2212: You stand on a shelf of level ground cut into the hillside, short-grassed and windy. Flat stones are ringed around a blackened fire pit that has been used many times. The steep hillside lies west, and a dark cave mouth yawns to the south. Smoke stains streak the rock above it.

2215.description: A broad, ragged mouth of black rock opens in the hillside here, ringed with piled skulls and cairns of broken stone. The smell of old meat and wet fur breathes out of the darkness. The cave itself lies east, while level ground is to the north, hills fall away south toward a distant shoreline, and a huge tree stands west. Deep gouges in the floor lead into the gloom.

2216.description: Inside the horrid cave the air is warm, close and foul. Rough walls sweat with moisture, and heaps of gnawed bones and filthy hides are piled in the corners. Little light reaches this far from the entrance, and the floor is slick with grease. The only way out is back west into the daylight.

rooms.2219: Wind sings across the hills above the shoreline, flattening the coarse grass in long ripples. The sea shows grey and endless far below, and gulls wheel as tiny white flecks. A cave mouth gapes north, the hills roll west, and a goat-track drops down a broken slope to the rocky shore. A leaning pile of stones marks the path's head.
rooms.2218: From the hills overlooking the shoreline you can see surf breaking on black rocks far below. The turf is thin and wiry, studded with sea-pink and thrift. Slopes continue north toward a huge tree, east and west along the hill, and a steep path drops down to the rocky shoreline. A single wind-bent thorn stands over the edge.
rooms.2214: A huge tree stands alone on the hilltop, its trunk gnarled and fissured, its roots clutching the stony slope. Strips of hide have been nailed into the bark, stiff and dark, and old arrowheads of flint litter the earth at its foot. The hill continues north up the slope, east to a dark cave, south along the ridge, and west through low foothills.
rooms.2213: These foothills are rolling and bare, grassed with wiry tussocks and dotted with pale outcrops. A shallow gully, scoured by old rains, runs away downhill. The hills rise gently north, east toward a huge tree, and south toward a view of the sea. The wind is steady and carries the tang of salt.
rooms.2211: The foothills are sparse and stony here, with a thin skin of heather over the rock. A broken stone wall, long fallen, can be traced across the slope by its line of mossy rubble. The ground climbs east toward a rocky hillside and rolls south through low hills. Nothing taller than a thistle grows within sight.
rooms.2217: The hills overlooking the shore end in a ragged edge, beyond which spreads a wide sweep of cold grey sea. Salt-burned heather scrubs the ground, and the wind pulls at your clothes. The hills continue north and east, and a steep scramble leads down to the rocky shore. Broken shells have been dropped across the turf by the sea birds.

2220.description: Wet black rocks, slimed with weed, litter the shore here, and the surf pounds them in slow booms. Tide pools hold small drifts of foam and crushed shells. The shore runs on east along the rocks, a waterline path leads south to the edge of the sea, and a steep slope climbs up to the hills. Everything is salt, spray and cold.

2221.description: The rocky shoreline is a jumble of boulders and shingle, polished by centuries of storm. A line of tangled kelp and driftwood marks the high tide. Shore stretches east and west along the foot of the cliffs, the edge of the sea lies south, and a steep path climbs to the hills above. Gulls scream overhead.

2222.description: Long grey waves run in against the rocky shore, hissing through the shingle. In the cliff face a dark gap opens to the north, damp and strangely quiet, from which a faint chill seeps. The shore continues west along the rocks, the edge of the sea lies south, and a steep path climbs back up to the hills. A wrecked oar lies jammed between the stones.

2225.description: Here the land gives out into the sea, and the grey water laps at the last broken stones. Barnacles crust every rock, and the wind carries a thin, bitter spray. The shore lies north, and the edge of the sea continues west along the stones. Far across the water the horizon is a blur of cloud.

2224.description: The land ends in a ledge of jagged rock where the sea heaves and sucks below. Beyond it, a strange blue light shines on the water, cold and unsteady. The shore lies north, the edge of the sea runs east and west, and the way south leads out onto the glow. Ice crusts the lowest stones.

2226.description: You drift on dark water in a strange cold light, blue as the heart of a glacier. Slabs of pale ice turn slowly around you, and the swell lifts and drops you without a sound. Shore lies back north, and a great shape of ice rises ahead, south. The air is bitter enough to ache in your lungs.

2253.description: A temple of ice rises out of the frozen sea, its walls and pillars cut from glacier as clear as glass. Blue light pours through the vaulted roof and glitters on carved ogre faces frozen in the walls. A broken altar of black stone stands in the middle, rimed with frost. Water lies back north, and the door south opens on bare snow and wind.

2251.description: A flat white waste of snow and ice stretches in every direction, scoured by a bitter wind. The cold bites through cloth and leather. No trail, post or landmark breaks the whiteness, and your own footprints fill with drifting snow almost as soon as they are made.

2223.description: A narrow beach of grey shingle lies at the edge of the sea, strewn with bleached bones of fish and seabirds. The waves slide in slow and heavy, trailing long ribbons of weed. Rocks rise north toward the shore, and the sea's edge runs east. A rusted iron ring has been driven into a boulder.

rooms.2208: A rocky path winds over broken stone, climbing and dropping among tumbled boulders. The rock here is grey and sharp, and little grows but lichens. The path leads north along a ridge and east toward a stained crossing. Fresh bones have been scattered along the verge, picked clean.
rooms.2209: The rocky path squeezes between two grey outcrops before it drops toward the trees. Chips of flint litter the track, and the stone is scored with long parallel gouges where something has dragged heavy timber. The path runs east to the edge of the forest and south among tumbled boulders.
rooms.2203: The forest thins into rough hills here: the last pines give way to heather and bare knuckles of rock. A trodden way leads north to a small intersection under the trees, and a stony path climbs west. A cairn of three flat stones, topped by a cracked skull, stands beside the track.
rooms.2232: Mist lies on the hummocks like wet wool, and the grass underfoot is silver with beaded damp. Every direction looks exactly like every other, and the only landmark is a lopsided mound that seems to drift from view as you approach. Somewhere a stream chuckles, always at the edge of hearing, never any nearer.
rooms.2234: A low ridge of black stone breaks the hillside here, its top furred with moss and lost in the fog. The mist is colder in the hollow beneath it and smells of iron and turned earth. Your own footsteps return from the grey as a muffled thump, as if another walker followed just out of sight.
rooms.2235: The hill dips into a bowl of heather, soaked and drooping under a ceiling of white mist. A few standing stones lean at odd angles, their lichen glowing faintly yellow in the murk. Moisture beads on your clothes and runs in thin lines down your face. You turn about and find you cannot tell where you entered.
rooms.2236: Tufts of rank grass and clumps of thistle dot a slope that rises and falls without reason. The mist is pierced here by a few thin spars of dead timber, bleached and splintered. Droplets fall from them in a steady tick, like a counting clock. Every direction gives the same view of grey.
rooms.2237: A shallow ford of black water winds through these misty hills, only inches deep and clouded with silt. Wet stepping-stones show for a moment and then dissolve into the whiteness. The fog is thick enough to taste, flat and mineral on the tongue. A dull drumbeat sounds from somewhere beyond the haze, or perhaps it is only your pulse.
rooms.2238: The mist thins to a ragged curtain among the last trees, and the trunks stand like dark bars against the pale air. A firmer track begins here, its surface beaten flat by many large feet, leading east out of the murk. Dead leaves hang motionless in the damp. The lost way behind you is a wall of wet grey.
rooms.2239: Solid ground at last: a causeway of packed stone and gravel runs over the hills, its edges laid out with big rough rocks. Wheel ruts and the deep prints of bare feet mark the surface. The path leads north into a forested track, and west back into the mist. A faint smell of cookfires sits on the breeze.
rooms.2240: A forested path winds between old firs, its surface trampled to a pale ribbon by heavy traffic. Bones and broken pots lie in the ditch, and strips of hide dangle from the low branches as warnings. The track runs north toward a distant palisade and south to a solid causeway. Thin smoke drifts through the treetops.
rooms.2241: A palisade of sharpened logs, each as thick as a barrel, bars the forest here, its points hung with skulls of every shape and size. A broad gate of lashed timber stands open to the north, flanked by two watchtowers of crude planks. Beyond it, the ogre village crowds around its cookfires. The track runs back south into the forest.
rooms.2243: You are just inside the gates of the ogre village, standing on churned and filthy ground. Crude huts of timber, mud and hide squat on either hand, and the great gate stands open to the south. A wide trodden way leads north toward a smoking firepit, with lanes running east and west among the huts. The stench of woodsmoke, meat and midden is overwhelming.
rooms.2246: A huge firepit smoulders in the middle of the clearing, ringed by blackened boulders and heaped with charred bones. Spits of green wood stand over the embers, still dripping fat. The great lodge of the ogre chieftain looms to the north, the village dump lies east, a gathering place west, and the gates lie back south.
rooms.2248: The entryway to the lodge is a long hall of massive uprights, hung with trophy skulls and the pelts of great beasts. Smoke curls through the rafters from a fire pit set in the floor, its glow flickering across mud-daubed walls. The way south leads out to the firepit, and wide doors lead north into the throne room. The floor is packed hard and greasy with spilled fat.
rooms.2249: The throne room is a vast timber hall black with smoke, its roof beams sagging under trophies of war. At its head stands a throne of piled bones and rough timber, draped with a bearskin. Torches gutter in iron cressets along the walls. A narrow doorway leads north to the chieftain's own room, and the hall opens back south to the entryway.
rooms.2250: The chieftain's room is a low, hot chamber, thick with the smell of musk and old grease. A bed of heaped furs and straw takes up one end, and war-trophies of every kind cover the walls, from broken shields to rusted helms. A single narrow window lets in a bar of pale smoke-stained light. The only way out is south, back into the throne room.
rooms.2247: The village dump is a stinking hollow heaped with gnawed bones, rotten hides and smashed pottery. Flies blacken every surface, and ragged scraps of cloth flutter from the refuse. The ground is soft and sour underfoot. A rutted path leads south among the huts, and another goes west to the firepit.
rooms.2244: Low huts of mud, timber and hide are crammed together here, their doors hung with stinking skins. Drying racks stand outside, strung with strips of grey meat and braided gut. A lane leads north to a heap of refuse, and another wanders west toward the village gates. The ground is trodden to filthy slurry.
rooms.2245: This is the gathering place of the ogres: a wide trampled square rimmed by log benches and smoke-blackened stumps. A tall pole planted in the centre bears a ring of sun-whitened skulls. The firepit and lodge are close to the east, and a lane leads south among the huts. Old bloodstains darken the packed earth.
rooms.2242: Crude huts squat shoulder to shoulder around this corner of the village, their roofs patched with hides and turf. A rusty cauldron the size of a cartwheel sits cold upon a tripod of lashed logs. A lane leads north to the gathering place, and another runs east toward the village gates. Bones, ashes and broken tools litter the mud.

2252.description: A flat plain of old snow stretches away under a pale, low sun. The wind combs long ridges across it, and every ridge looks the same. The cold is so intense that your breath turns to needles of rime in the air.

2254.description: Wind has carved the drifts here into fluted, frozen waves with knife-edged crests. A scatter of black rock breaks through the snow, glazed with ice. Nothing moves, and the only sound is the dry hiss of blown crystals. The cold gnaws your fingers and the tip of your nose.

2255.description: A long frozen stream lies beneath a skin of wind-polished ice, so clear that you can see stones and trapped leaves deep inside. Banks of old snow rise on both sides. Cracks run through the ice with sudden groaning reports. The sky overhead is a dull steel colour, promising more snow.

2256.description: The snow is churned here by huge, deep tracks which end in frozen puddles, and bones of some great animal jut from the drift, coated in frost. A few shreds of fur flutter from a ragged post of driftwood. The cold is relentless and the horizon is lost in a whiteness that merges with the sky.

2257.description: A great boulder of blue-white ice squats in the snow, taller than a hut, its flanks scoured smooth by the wind. Icicles hang from every lip like fangs. Past it, the waste runs away into haze, featureless and still. Your eyes sting with the glare.

2258.description: The waste rises into a low snowy ridge, bare of anything but rime and a few dark ribs of stone. The wind comes in hard across the crest and fills the air with stinging crystals. A faint trail of packed snow leads south down the slope to the edge of the wastes. A pale, cold glow lingers in the overcast sky.

2260.description: Here the frigid wastes end against a towering wall of dark rock streaked with ice. A steep stair of frozen steps has been hacked into the cliff, climbing to a keep whose broken towers hang above the cold. A path leads north back onto the wastelands. Wind howls down the stair and tears at your clothes.

2259.description: A hollow in the snow holds the splintered wreck of a sledge, half buried and glazed with ice. Beside it a ring of stones surrounds the black scar of a long-dead fire. The drifts roll away on every side, white and silent. The cold settles into your joints like iron.

4308.description: The great oak is hung with offerings: knotted cords, small skulls and strips of red cloth. The hide ladder looks sturdy enough to bear an ogre.

4307.description: The water drops about three times a man's height onto black stones. Behind the veil there is only a wet rock face.

4303.description: The ribs are enormous, curved and yellowed like the frame of a wrecked boat. Whatever owned them died here long ago.

2207.description: The stones have been stained so many times they no longer dry. Hundreds of knucklebones have been pressed into the clay between them.

2253.description: The altar is a single slab of black stone, split down the middle. Dark old stains have soaked into its top beneath the frost.

2241.description: The skulls on the palisade range from wolf to bear to man, most of them cracked open. The gate hinges are bound with hide and thick as a man's waist.

2246.description: The pit has burned for so long that its boulders have cracked in the heat. Bones of every kind jut from the ashes, and the char is a hand deep.

2249.description: The throne is made of leg bones and jawbones lashed together with sinew. The bearskin that covers the seat is big enough to wrap three men.

creatures.long_desc: A black forest wolf prowls the shadows, its lip curled over yellow fangs.
creatures.description: This wolf is lean and shaggy, its pelt matted with burrs and old blood. It lives off what the ogres leave behind and has lost all fear of men.

creatures.long_desc: A giant rock crab scuttles among the wet boulders, claws raised in threat.
creatures.description: The crab is as broad as a shield, its shell crusted with barnacles and weed. One heavy claw is far larger than the other, and it clacks open and shut like a trap.

creatures.long_desc: A hulking ogre lumbers about, scratching its belly and glaring at strangers.
creatures.description: The ogre stands head and shoulders above a man, its yellowed hide hung with patchwork furs and its belly swollen with its last feast. Small, mean eyes fix on you from under a heavy brow, and a knotted club sits easy in one huge fist.

creatures.long_desc: A scarred ogre warlord stands guard, thick arms folded across a plated chest.
creatures.description: Old battle scars crisscross this ogre's hide, and one ear has been torn to a ragged stump. He is armoured with plates of beaten iron lashed to his chest and wears a helm made from a horned skull. A huge maul rests across his shoulder.

creatures.long_desc: A gaunt frost troll stalks the drifts, rimed with ice from crown to toe.
creatures.description: The troll is tall and stooped, its skin pale blue and cracked like frozen mud. Long icicles hang from its chin and knuckles, and its breath smokes in the cold.
rooms: The Edge Of The Frigid Wastes

creatures.long_desc: Grushka the Bone-Caller, the ogre shaman, mutters over a rattling string of knucklebones.
creatures.description: Grushka is a stooped, hook-nosed ogre hung from head to foot with bones, feathers and dried paws. His eyes are milky white and his lips never stop moving as he mutters curses over a staff of lashed ribs.

creatures.long_desc: Brogg Skullsplitter, the Ogre Chieftain, looms over his chamber with a monstrous maul in hand.
creatures.description: Brogg is the largest ogre you have ever seen, his shoulders as wide as a doorway and his arms thick as tree trunks. A necklace of fingerbones swings across his chest, and the head of his maul is crusted with old gore.

items.room_desc: A black wolf pelt lies here.
items.description: A thick, coarse pelt of black wolf fur, rank but sound. Furriers would pay a fair price for it.

items.room_desc: A stiff ogre-hide jerkin lies here.
items.description: A jerkin of thick, hardened hide stitched with gut. It stinks of smoke and grease but turns a blow well.

items.room_desc: A horned iron helm lies here.
items.description: A helm of beaten iron, crudely riveted, with horns of bone curving from the brow. It is battered and too big for most men, but it is strong.
A string of tiny knucklebones, feathers and polished teeth, knotted with sinew. A faint, uneasy hum seems to come from it.

items.room_desc: A monstrous ogre maul lies here.
items.description: A massive maul of iron-bound oak, crowned with the stone-hard skull of a bull. Its head is stained a deep brown, and it is heavy enough to break bone with a single swing.
